summary: A website called CropWise AI hosts a narrow AI model called Sami, which helps farmers to do proper crop rotation so that they avoid problems like those in Iowa, USA. The model could achieve 99.5% accuracy based on the training data.
details: A website called CropWise AI hosts a narrow AI model called Sami. The model is based on a classification machine learning algorithm called support vector machine (SVM). The model provides the ability to choose the cover crop that should be used for utilization of the gap between planting the same crop. This utilizes the remainder of the fertilizers instead of their precipitation and sweeps them into the water, causing many diseases. To utilize the fields and opportunities that are wasted due to lack of awareness. The solution was made using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, run with Jupyter Notebook. Farmers can easily access and interact with it. The website contains a business section that shows financial savings that have been achieved after applying the solution for 5 years in Iowa, USA. The model could achieve a high accuracy of 99.5%.
